description: Making AI Work: The Assam government has signed multiple MoUs with organizations to enhance artificial intelligence in school education, focusing on teacher training, literacy improvement, and personalized learning for students.
body_lead: Assam signs multiple MoUs to scale AI in school education The partnerships with Google AI, IIT Madras-Bodhan AI, Wadhwani AI and others will focus on teacher training, personalised learning, foundational literacy and digital skills. The Assam government has signed memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with six organisations to introduce and expand the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in school education across the state, education minister Ranoj Pegu said on Friday.
